exposure: Introduction of caps on noneconomic damages (medical malpractice reform)
cohort: The study included discharge data for births occurring in North Carolina and Florida.
finding: Caps on noneconomic damages causally reduce the likelihood of a cesarean delivery by an average of 5%.
mod_finding: Caps on noneconomic damages causally reduce the likelihood of cesarean delivery, and physicians substitute away from other intensive procedures like vacuum and forceps deliveries, but increase medical inductions.
